priority: FLARE; Gnomix is a required native-method comparator
purpose: Standardized observed-only common-panel pilot, not full-array certification
panel: Exact CHROM/POS/REF/ALT intersection of typed array sites and the frozen 197260-site common reference panel; report excluded sites and coverage
reference: Same 3447 identity-disjoint, seven-source-labelled reference people for every method
training: Gnomix reference-only base and existing disjoint 307-pure/492-pedigree smoother; no evaluation truth used in fitting
evaluation: Existing hash/MILP-selected seven pure and seven balanced pedigree controls; seen-donor development pilot, not independent certification

phasing.primary: Singleton phase-only processing of complete typed GTs with the matching reference panel
phasing.missing_gt: Fail explicitly; never fill, pad or substitute DS
phasing.diagnostic: Original inherited phase on exactly the same typed markers

aggregation: Posterior means weighted by physical midpoint cells over the original half-open chromosome spans; include both copies equally
truth: Original full-physical-span realized ancestry; never replace with marker-count truth
reporting: Separate mask, phase condition, pure/pedigree track and native/calibrated method; no partial-autosome leaderboard or winner selection on this pilot
flare_policy: Native seven-source reference panels; no inherited GMM decoder or old WGS-trained copying model; EM, when enabled, is singleton and update-p=false
gnomix_policy: Refit on each exact observed-marker panel; genuine pinned upstream LR+CRF, no SVM, no missing-marker padding; 2 cM is predeclared for sparse arrays
calibration: None in the initial native-method pilot; any future learned calibration is a separately named, donor-purged track
